parameters.name: BindType
parameters.description:
The binding type. Default value: user. Valid values:

- user: binding for a regular user scenario.

- lingo: binding for a lingo scenario.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description: The Git platform. Valid values: GitHub, GitLab.
